registered_addition_groups.owner: M3-B C2 phone fatigue-pressure witness core
registered_addition_groups.rationale: These findings are bounded canonical SHA-256 review material and local sequence/schema validation for the phone fatigue-pressure witness. The encode call hashes canonical witness material, set() only validates strictly increasing logical ticks, and the subscript assignment adds the final public-review digest to a newly constructed local mapping. The core installs no runtime hook, registers no attestation or verifier, retains no observation, mutates no live affect/goal/registry-owner state, starts no observation window, and grants no M3 or cutover authority.

registered_addition_groups.owner: M3-B C2 operator phone fatigue-pressure witness CLI
registered_addition_groups.rationale: These operations are confined to the operator witness helper: repository-root sys.path bootstrap, creation of an operator-selected private directory, parsing the current process's own context-switch counters, and atomic writes to that private directory. The root must resolve outside the repository and private material stays permission-restricted. The helper does not touch EVE persistence, register production trust, retain a real observation through the M3-B sink, mutate live affect/goal state, start an observation window, or change runtime/cutover authority.
